biotools.summary: DENSE-SIM is an open-source simulation pipeline for generating realistic cine DENSE images with high-resolution known ground-truth strain, enabling evaluation of accuracy and precision in strain analysis pipelines. It comprises modules for anatomy generation, motion generation, DENSE image generation, and strain evaluation.
